classification: Quantitative research, pricing and risk toolkit; not a proven Binance trading strategy
license: Apache-2.0; preserve applicable attribution and notices if reusing code
runtime_change: NONE: not installed, not imported into execution, no new external dependency
data_access_boundary: Open-source code does not grant access to Goldman Sachs data/pricing APIs; institutional client credentials may be required

existing_local_capabilities.capability: Single-symbol next-bar replay with explicit fees, slippage and funding inputs
Train/test separated windows; not a shared-capital multi-symbol portfolio
Fill-aware MFE/MAE, gross excursions; not executable peak profit
Explicit unproven historical arrivals/universe/funding/cost stress/independent validation flags

deployment_caveat: Repository presence does not mean adoption by the active trading process. Do not bulk-deploy unpublished research with the quota hotfix.

recommended_order.feature: Signal-to-fill event timeline and delay-cost comparison
recommended_order.benefit: Measure whether faster consumption improves net outcomes, rather than optimizing latency alone
requirements: Event time and arrival time both constrain historical visibility
Compare same candidate and exit/cost assumptions
Separate missed opportunity from avoided chasing
Never fill unknown quotes from future data

recommended_order.feature: Component cost model and reconciled trade attribution
requirements: Actual gross PnL minus fees plus funding reconciles to ledger net PnL
Decision-to-submit delay and submit-to-fill slippage reported separately
Do not deduct execution slippage twice from realized PnL
Low/base/high cost assumptions are simulations, not observed results
One capital pool and actual signal ordering
Account for existing positions and concurrent candidates
Model funding, unavailable capacity and rebalance costs
State assumptions, not uncalibrated event probabilities
Research first; no automatic new hard entry veto

do_not_copy_blindly: PricingContext and GenericEngine remote valuation dependencies
Whole-series interpolation that may use future endpoints
Assuming full fills at modeled prices proves venue executability
Interest-rate or option sample parameters as evidence for crypto perpetual profitability
validation: This is source and local-code review, not a performance backtest or evidence of profitability
